The answer names `programs` as a top-level directory with MBEDTLS_PRIVATE uses. That covers `programs/ssl/ssl_context_info.c` and `programs/fuzz/fuzz_dtlsserver.c`. It also names `programs/ssl/ssl_server2.c` and `ssl_client2.c`, but only as defining the opt-out macro.

It names `library` as well. `library/common.h` and `library/ssl_misc.h` appear as the places that define or include the opt-out. It says internal library code uses the real field names. Its only direct uses of the macro in header inlines are in `include/mbedtls/ssl.h` and `include/mbedtls/psa/crypto_struct.h`, so it also names `include`.

The answer also cites `docs/3.0-migration-guide.md`, but only as a description of the intent, not as containing uses.

ITEMS:
programs
include
library
END
